title: Affine subspace membership in dimension zero
statement: Let $V$ be a linear subspace of the zero-dimensional binary vector space, let $a$ be a vector in that space, and let $w$ be a Boolean assignment on the empty coordinate set. The binary vector corresponding to $w$ lies in the affine subspace obtained by translating $V$ by $a$.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is a subspace of the zero-dimensional binary vector space
$a$ is a vector in that space
$w$ is a Boolean assignment on the empty coordinate set
